notes: Rule 52: the `לְ` before the infinitive construct, recast as a finite temporal clause, takes *When* and the infinitive keeps the passive recasting *are cut off*.
`תַּחְתָּם` splits into the preposition with *in ... place*, headed on the lexeme-bearing *place* under rule 24, and the suffix with *their*; the marginal *Hebrew go up* was set aside under rule 38.
